title: Voxy Optimized
description: Based on Distantly Optimized, now with Voxy, for improved LoD support, and even more FPS!
body:
Based on the same configuration and optmization mods of Distantly Optimized, this is an optimized modpack for Voxy.

![A Minecraft Dark Forest biome, with a tall, snowy mountain in the background.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/maVcCDRb/images/463c10dadd0ae3977f237fbaa574b6e06788aa12_350.webp)

Featuring several mods to improve not only worldgen performance, but also your experience with Voxy. This modpack:

- Features faster world generation
- Generates distant chunks and allows Voxy to use them
- Includes several shaders that support Voxy
- Includes multiple performance mods that make normal rendering faster
- Allows servers with Voxy Server Side to send LoD data to your client, giving you distant terrain without having to actually visit every chunk
